decisions.reason: After two years the niche glass-flake spraying system has had time to show demand, so weak traction would matter more now, but its close technical fit and likely low carrying cost still support keeping the option open.

The low-pressure injection pump sits very close to the firm's core equipment range and likely shares production, service, and sales resources with existing products, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.

Fire protection flow monitoring fits the firm's push toward digitalized and interoperable customer solutions, but as a less proven adjacent offer it still carries a moderate risk of being dropped if market uptake stays limited.
The hydraulic two-component spraying system is a recent launch close to the established offer, so its option value for continued market learning remains high and the firm would keep it for now.
